title: Python Programming Fundamentals
description: Learn Python programming fundamentals including variables, functions, data structures, modules, and object-oriented programming.

title: SQL and Database Design
description: Learn SQL queries, relational database concepts, table relationships, joins, normalization, and database design.

title: Backend Development with FastAPI
description: Build backend applications and REST APIs using Python, FastAPI, request validation, authentication, and database integration.

title: Machine Learning Foundations
description: Understand supervised learning, unsupervised learning, feature engineering, model training, and machine learning evaluation.

title: Natural Language Processing
description: Learn natural language processing, text preprocessing, language models, embeddings, text classification, and semantic search.

title: Deep Learning and Neural Networks
description: Explore deep learning, neural networks, model optimization, computer vision, and modern artificial intelligence techniques.

title: Data Analysis with Python
description: Analyze and visualize data using Python, NumPy, data cleaning, statistical analysis, and practical analytics techniques.

title: Git and GitHub Essentials
description: Learn version control using Git, GitHub repositories, branches, commits, merging, collaboration, and pull requests.

title: Docker for Backend Developers
description: Learn Docker containers, images, Dockerfiles, containerized backend applications, and deployment workflows.

title: Cloud Computing Fundamentals
description: Understand cloud computing, cloud services, deployment, scalability, storage, networking, and cloud application architecture.
